_comment: YuzuFox prefs that legitimately have no entry in Firefox's all.js / firefox.js / StaticPrefList.yaml. Checked by scripts/check_firefox.py. Keep this file tiny and always explain why the pref still exists.

prefs.browser.contentblocking.category: written and applied by the ContentBlockingPrefs category machinery, not a default pref
prefs.browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.feeds: Activity Stream pref read from the newtab modules with a built-in fallback
Activity Stream system-gate pref read from the newtab modules
Activity Stream system-gate pref read from the newtab modules
Activity Stream feed pref read from the newtab modules
prefs.browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.showS: Activity Stream pref read from the newtab modules
Activity Stream pref read from the newtab modules
Activity Stream pref read from the newtab modules
prefs.browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.syste: Activity Stream system-gate pref read from the newtab modules
prefs.browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.telem: Activity Stream pref read from the newtab modules
prefs.browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.unifi: Activity Stream unified-ads pref read from the newtab modules
prefs.browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.widge: Firefox 156+ newtab widgets pref read from the newtab modules
Firefox 156+ newtab widgets system-gate pref read from the newtab modules
prefs.browser.search.serpEventTelemetryCategor: SERP telemetry pref read by the search telemetry module
prefs.browser.startup.homepage_override.mstone: read and written by the startup/update machinery
prefs.extensions.enabledScopes: read by the add-on manager with a built-in fallback
prefs.extensions.getAddons.showPane: read by about:addons with a built-in fallback
prefs.intl.locale.requested: read by the locale service, empty means follow the system locale
prefs.network.file.disable_unc_paths: read by the file URI code on Windows only
prefs.pdfjs.enableScripting: default lives in the PDF.js default prefs inside the gre omni, not in all.js/firefox.js
prefs.spellchecker.dictionary_path: read by the spellcheck service from the environment
prefs.toolkit.telemetry.cachedClientID: telemetry state pref, written/read by TelemetryUtils
prefs.toolkit.telemetry.cachedProfileGroupID: telemetry state pref, written/read by TelemetryUtils
prefs.toolkit.telemetry.enabled: read by the telemetry modules, not a default pref
prefs.toolkit.telemetry.updatePing.enabled: lost its default in Firefox 157; still referenced by the shipped telemetry pref map, kept defensively
